name: Bakunyuu Oyakodon ~Shigoto Saki no Oyako ga Netori Yasu Sou na Ken~
original_name: 爆乳母娘丼 ～仕事先の親子が寝取りやすそうな件～
source:
The protagonist is an electrician who lives an uneventful life. However, one day he is called to the Tanimura household, and by meeting the busty mother and daughter - Kyoko and Mei - his life began to change.


[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE249330.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名过着平淡生活的电工。然而某天，他接到前往谷村家的工作，在那里遇见了身材丰满的母女京子与芽衣，他的人生就此开始改变。

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE249330.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
